entities.summary: Nikolaus Scherak is an Austrian politician of NEOS – The New Austria and Liberal Forum who has been a member of the National Council since 2013. Between 2018 and 2021, he served as co-deputy chairman of NEOS. Prior, he was the leader of JuLis – Young Liberals Austria, a liberal youth organisation, which under his leadership, became the youth wing of NEOS.
